争分夺秒，志在夺取有利位置。: Racing against the clock to seize the advantageous position.

先发制人，抢占先机。: Strike first and seize the initiative.

摧枯拉朽，力拔山兮。: Crushing all before it like rotten wood, with strength enough to uproot mountains.
